name: Il-Ħofra tal-Bidwin
description: Blue Hole: a natural sinkhole in the rock at Dwejra, about 15 m deep and sheltered from the sea. An underwater window at about 9 m leads to the open sea, and a big cave lies on the far side. Often combined with Coral Gardens, the Azure Window reef or the Inland Sea.
conditions: 200 m walk over rough rock with all gear. Good in the afternoon when other sites get rough.
